latest_protocol_summary.issue: Chat/run history did not open from <local-control-plane-host> dashboard.

Nginx kept stale Docker upstream IPs after service recreates.
Recent task listing performed many single Redis GET calls.
Frontend dashboard refresh loop overloaded the browser/network path.
Root-level optional Docker sidecars had unrelated restart loops.
fixes: Rebuilt agent-api/frontend and verified the history route.
Added dynamic Docker DNS resolver behavior in infrastructure/nginx/dev.conf.
Optimized Redis recent-task loading with MGET chunking.
Split frontend load groups and refresh intervals.
Added browser-contract session history regression guard.
Repaired root codex sandbox health runner and removed invalid optional MCP restart loops.
